findings.title: Default update-strategy tests never enable rolling-updates
findings.body: createInitialDeployment returns immediately when updateStrategy is null, before enabling Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES. Both parameterized tests include null (the documented default strategy), and testCacheMaxCount(null) expects a successful rolling update. The new operator guide states that while this is preview the rolling-updates feature must be enabled or the Operator fails. Those cases therefore either fail reconciliation or never exercise the feature the PR says is now required.

findings.title: Enabling rolling-updates wipes other CR features
findings.body: When an update strategy is set, the helper replaces the entire enabled-features list with List.of(rolling-updates) instead of appending to any features already on the FeatureSpec. If getTestKeycloakDeployment (or a future caller) has already enabled features, they are dropped on the CR. The server then starts without those features, so upgrade tests can fail or pass for the wrong reason.

findings.title: Disabled-feature test never checks exit code 4
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only asserts the stderr text. The contract added in this PR is that metadata/check exit 4 when rolling-updates is disabled (and recreate was moved to 3 so 4 is no longer 'recreate'). Automation is documented to branch on that code. A regression that prints the message but exits 0, 1, or 3 would still pass this test.
